# Synthetic changedrop fixture

Players can see two independently evidenced improvements.

## Features

### The window follows its new size
Before this change, resizing could leave the editor view stale. After the change, the view follows the window. Players keep the HUD aligned without reopening the editor.

Evidence: img/window-follow-focused-annotated.png

### Demo pause follows engine state
Before this change, lining up a HUD meant waiting for a useful frame. After the change, Pause and Resume follow engine state. Players can make precise edits on a stable frame.

Evidence: img/pause-resume-focused-annotated.png
